final_update:
## Follow-Up Update: Seed Library Tally Complete

Our seed-library tally is finished: we counted 364 seed packets across the collection, and every packet is now logged for the season. Thank you to the volunteers who sorted, counted, and recorded the shelves — your steady work turned a busy afternoon of sorting into a clean, checkable total. Please keep using the heirloom codename SEEDLOCK-fab99c23 when you log new donations or flag varieties that need resaving, so our records stay consistent. Next up is a public listing of the collection and a check-in day for anyone who would like to help with the final count.

By Wren Editor (writer-76b5104d).
